Sugar - the silent killer

By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Should sugar products come with a warning label? Research increasingly suggests that sugar is as addictive as alcohol and even cocaine.

Summary:
Many of us as children were told not to eat sugar because it would rot our teeth.. But what if we had been told don’t eat too much sugar because it can cause obesity, diabetes, cataracts, mood related issues, addiction, promote the growth of cancer, heart disease and liver failure. Because that is the reality of the toll that added sugar can and probably will have on your health.

In recent studies, sugar is regarded as being an addictive substance. Some researchers say, as addictive as cocaine.

We look into the science behind why sugar is regarded as begin addictive. Speak to a neuro scientist, nutritionist, dietician and psychiatrist and ask them if sugar is addictive and why? Our 2 case studies demonstrate just how addictive sugar can be through their personal stories.

We also look at hidden sugars and diseases that sugar can cause.



Case Study:
Boniwe Yaka
Michele Riley sugar addict

Expert:
Mr. Ian Craig
Mrs. Karen Thomson
Mrs. Claire Julsing-Strydom
Prof. Christopher Szabo
Dr. Nicole Avena

Press Release:


Sugar Addiction
Obsession with sugary food has been described as similar to drug addiction. Why are some people unable to consume sugar in moderation even when facing devastating lifestyle-related health complications? Carte Blanche considers the latest science on sugar intake and drops in on SA’s first sugar rehabilitation clinic.




























Script:


BONIWE
WHEN I WAKE UP IN THE MORNING, ALREADY I AM CRAVING SUGAR.

MICHELLE
CHIPS, CHOCOLATE, BIG SLABS OF CHOCOLATE.

I WOULD WALK UP AND DOWN THE AISLES IF I FILLED THE TROLLEY, NOT ENOUGH FOOD TO FILL THE HOLE INSIDE ME.

I WOULD … EAT ALL THAT FOOD IN ONE GO.

BONIWE
I HAVE TO CONSUME IT ALL, RIGHT NOW.

MICHELLE
I WOULD FEEL SO SICK .. IT WOULD BE A MATTER OF HOURS WHEN THAT FEELING HAD GONE, I WOULD LOOK FOR SOMETHING ELSE TO EAT.

KAREN – CLIP 1
I CANNOT HAVE 1 LINE OF COCAINE, I HAVE TO CUT OUT ONE GLASS OF WINE. BECAUSE FOR ME ONE IS TOO MANY AND A THOUSAND IS NEVER ENOUGH. ONCE I START I CANNOT STOP AND THAT IS WHAT ADDICTION IS.

DEVI LINK
WHEN WE THINK OF ADDICTIVE SUBSTANCES – DRUGS, ALCOHOL AND CIGARETTES COME TO MIND.
BUT SCIENTISTS AROUND THE GLOBE SCIENTISTS ARE CLAIMING THAT SUGAR SHOULD ALSO BE CLASSIFIED AS AN ADDICTIVE SUBSTANCE.

NICOLE
SEVERAL RESEARCH STUDIES HAVE SHOWN THAT OVER CONSUMPTION OF SUGAR CAN HIJACK THE BRAIN IN MANY WAYS – SIMILAR TO WHAT YOU SEE WHEN SOMEONE IS USING A DRUG LIKE ALCOHOL OR NICOTINE.

INTRO NICOLE AVENA
DR. NICOLE AVENA IS A RESEARCH NEUROSCIENTIST AT PRINCETON UNIVERSITY. SHE IS ALSO AN AUTHOR AND EXPERT IN THE FIELDS OF NUTRITION, DIET AND ADDICTION.

NICOLE
RESEARCHERS HAVE USED THE CRITERIA SUCH AS TOLERANCE, THE EMERGENCE OF WITHDRAWAL SIGNS, CRAVING, CHANGES IN THE BRAIN ARE ALL CONSISTENT WITH ADDICTION TO DRUGS OF ABUSE AND FOOD AND SUGAR IN PARTICULAR.




DEVI LINK:
PEOPLE WHO DEMONSTRATE ADDICTIVE BEHAVIOR ARE MORE PRONE TO SUGAR ADDICTION, ESPECIALLY WHEN CONSUMED IN EXCESSIVE AMOUNTS.

VO:
A STUDY CONDUCTED BY RESEARCHERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF BORDEAUX USING LAB RATS, FOUND THE RATS’ ADDICTION TO SUGAR TO BE FOUR TIMES GREATER THAN TO COCAINE.

BUT HEAD OF PSYCHIATRY AT WITS , PROFESSOR CHRISTOPHER SZABO, DOES NOT AGREE THAT THIS RESEARCH IS CONCLUSIVE.

PROFESSOR SZABO:
THE JURY IS OUT. WHILST WE’VE GOT AN APPEALING CONCEPT. THE SCIENCE IS NOT SAYING UNEQUIVOCALLY THAT SUGAR IS A SUBSTANCE OF ADDICTION.

VO: **
THE SOUTH AFRICAN SUGAR ASSOCIATION SAYS THAT ADDICTION TO SUGAR IS A MYTH.

PROFESSOR SZABO:
IF ONE UNDERSTANDS ADDICTION, IT IS ALL ABOUT REWARD… WHY SUGAR IS SO APPEALING, RAPIDLY ABSORBED , YOU GET A REWARD, PLEASURE.

VO:
WHEN YOU EAT SUGAR, DOPAMINE IS RELEASED AND IT STIMULATES THE REWARD CENTRE OF THE BRAIN LEAVING YOU FEELING GOOD AND WANTING MORE. BUT OVER-ACTIVATION OF THE REWARD SYSTEM VIA EXCESSIVE SUGAR CONSUMPTION WILL KICK START LOSS OF CONTROL, CRAVINGS AND AN INCREASED TOLERANCE TO SUGAR, SIMILAR TO THE EFFECT OF SOME HARD DRUGS.

DEVI:
HOW DO YOU FEEL WHEN YOU EAT A CHOCOLATE DESSERT, IMMEDIATELY AFTER?

BONIWE :
SO GOOD.

VO:
BONIWE IS A SELF CONFESSED SUGAR ADDICT. SHE COMPULSIVELY EATS ANYTHING AND EVERYTHING THAT CONTAINS SUGAR.

WHEN DID THIS START?

BONIWE
LOOK, IT HAS ALWAYS BEEN THERE. I THINK I CAME TO REALISE I WAS AN ADDICT ABOUT THREE YEARS AGO.
….
DURING THAT TIME ON A DAILY BASIS I WOULD GO AND BUY WOOLIES CHOC DESSERTS AND EAT ALL OF AT ONCE, IN 15 MINUTES ITS GONE.

DEVI
THE LITTLE CONTAINERS ..

BONIWE
THE BIG ONE. THE BIG TUB. THEN I WOULD EAT THE TRIPLE CHOC DESSERT, BUT IT WOULDN’T BE ONLY THAT. IT WOULD BE CHUCKLES AS WELL – THE 250 GRAMS.


DEVI:
SO IT IS POSSIBLE TO BECOME ADDICTIVE TO SOMETHING LIKE SUGAR BECAUSE IT MAKES YOU FEEL GOOD?


PROF SZABO
SUGAR INTERESTING ONE. REPEATEDLY EXPOSED, BECOMES MORE DIFFICULT TO RESIST.
IS THAT ADDICTION? THAT IS WHAT PEOPLE ARE GRAPPLING WITH IN TERMS OF COMING TO A FINAL UNDERSTANDING - YES, SUGAR IS A SUBSTANCE OF ADDICTION.


VO:
STUDIES INTO THE FIELD OF SUGAR ADDICTION HAVE BEEN CONDUCTED FOR THE PAST 10 TO 15 YEARS WITH MUCH OF THE INITIAL RESEARCH BEING DONE ON LAB RATS. IT IS ONLY REALLY IN THE PAST 5 YEARS THAT STUDIES ON HUMANS HAVE EMERGED.

DEVI LINK
SUGAR ADDICTION EXHIBITS IN THE SAME WAY IN BOTH MEN WOMEN. WREAKING HAVOC WITH THEIR WEIGHT, LIVES AND EMOTIONS.


KAREN
MY SUGAR ADDICTION STARTED WHEN I WAS 4. EXPERIENCED TRAUMA, COULDN’T VERBALIZE AND SO I STARTED REWARDING MYSELF AND SOOTHING MYSELF WITH SUGAR.
MY SUGAR ADDICTION WAS MY GATEWAY ADDICTION INTO OTHER ADDICTIONS.

VO:
KAREN IS A RECOVERING SUGAR, ALCOHOL AND COCAINE ADDICT. SHE WORKS WITH DRUG, ALCOHOL AND SUGAR ADDICTS EVERY DAY AT HARMONY REHAB CENTRE IN CAPE TOWN WHERE SHE RUNS THE SUGAR ADDICTION PROGRAMME.


JOHN:
HOW WOULD YOU DEFINE ADDICTIVE BEHAVIOR:

KAREN
A COMPULSIVE PURSUIT OF A SUBSTANCE TO MAKE US FEEL SOMETHING DIFFERENT. DESPITE NEGATIVE CONSEQUENCES, KEEP GOING BACK FOR MORE.

DEVI
SOMEONE WITH ADDICTION, WOULD DO WHAT?

PROF SZABO
SEEK OUT THE SUBSTANCE COME WHAT MAY..

KAREN
THERE ARE SUGAR ADDICTS WHO WILL EAT OUT OF A BIN TO GET THAT PIECE OF CHOCOLATE THREW AWAY. A LOT OF PEOPLE WILL MAKE THEIR CAR THEIR SANCTUARY, UNDER THE SEATS THEY HAVE STUFFED THE WRAPPERS AND THEY ARE ASHAMED.
PEOPLE GET UP IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT LEAVE THEIR KIDS IN BED, THAT’S DANGEROUS.


VO:
ACCORDING TO CLAIRE JULSING–STRYDOM, PRESIDENT OF THE ASSOCIATION FOR DIETETICS IN SOUTH AFRICA, FOOD ADDICTION IS A MORE APPROPRIATE TERM THAN SUGAR ADDICTION.

DEVI:
IS SUGAR ADDICTIVE?
CLAIRE:
IF WE LOOK AT FOOD ADDICTION, I THINK PEOPLE ARE MORE PRONE TO ADDICTIVE BEHAVIORS ARE MORE LIKELY TO HAVE IT. IT CAN BE SUGAR, PROCESSED FOODS, OR FAT. IT VARIES FOR DIFFERENT INDIVIDUALS.

VO:
DR AVENA RAN A STUDY TO DETERMINE IF OTHER FOODS - LIKE FAT - ARE AS ADDICTIVE AS SUGAR. ONCE AGAIN, RATS WERE PUT TO THE TEST.

NICOLE:
WHEN WE LOOK AT STUDIES THAT COMPARE SUGAR AND FAT..
ANIMALS THAT HAVE A HIGH SUGAR DIET THAT ARE MORE LIKELY TO SHOW THESE ADDICTIVE LIKE BEHAVIOR AND EFFECT ON THE BRAIN.




VO
BONIWE IS AWARE THAT SHE IS OVERWEIGHT AND HAS A PROBLEM. HER FRIDGE IS PLASTERED WITH HEALTHY FOOD PLANS, WHICH SHE DESPERATELY TRIES TO STICK TO.
BUT SIMPLY CAN’T.


BONIWE
EVERY DAY WHEN I TAKE A SHOWER, THAT’S WHEN REALITY KICKS IN – YOU DON’T LIKE YOURSELF LIKE THIS BONIWE. BUT WHY ARE YOU DOING THIS TO YOURSELF?

DEVI
ARE THERE EMOTIONAL TRIGGERS?

BONIWE
I’M PRONE TO STRESS. SO, WHEN I START STRESSING - THERE GOES MY HEALTHY EATING.


DEVI:
BONIWE, OUR CASE STUDY, SHE SAYS SHE IS ADDICTED TO SUGAR. DOES THIS REPRESENT A DEEPER PSYCHOLOGICAL ISSUE?

PROFESSOR SZABO
ONE HAS TO UNDERSTAND THE RELATIONSHIP A PERSON HAS TO THIS SUBSTANCE. WHAT DOES IT GIVE YOU THAT YOU MIGHT TRY TO ACHIEVE THROUGH SOMETHING ELSE IN A MORE FUNCTIONAL WAY.


BONIWE
SOMETIMES IT’S SAD THAT I HAVE NO CONTROL. I COULD BE EATING MYSELF TO DEATH.


VO:
THE TRUTH IS, THAT SHE COULD BE. SUGAR HAS MOST RECENTLY BEEN LINKED TO NON-ALCOHOLIC FATTY LIVER DISEASE. AT ITS MOST SEVERE, THIS CONDITION CAN PROGRESS TO LIVER FAILURE. SUGAR HAS ALSO BEEN LINKED TO OBESITY, DIABETES, CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE, CATARACTS, MOOD DISORDERS AND EVEN THE GROWTH OF CANCER.

CLAIRE COMMENT
THE ISSUE WITH … BECOMING OVERWEIGHT AS WELL.

JOHN WEBB: MICHELLE INTRO LINK
AT HER HEAVIEST MICHELLE RILEY WEIGHED 144 KILOGRAMS, SHE TURNED TO SUGARY FOODS TO NUMB DEEP SEATED EMOTIONS.

JOHN
HOW DO YOU SEE SUGAR?

MICHELLE
I SEE IT AS EVIL. IT ROBBED ME OF MY YOUTH, AND EXPERIENCING THINGS WITH MY FAMILY.

THINKING BACK - THE AMOUNT OF SHAME I FELT. HOW I THOUGHT IT WAS SOMETHING WRONG WITH ME.. YOU GET TO A VERY LOW PLACE.

BONIWE
PEOPLE MIGHT SEE A BUBBLY PERSON ON THE OUTSIDE, ON THE INSIDE I’M A MESS AND I
FEEL I CAN’T FIX MYSELF.

KAREN RECEIVES UP TO 20 EMAILS A DAY FROM PEOPLE SEEKING HELP FOR SUGAR ADDICTION. IN 2012, MICHELE JOINED THE HARMONY PROGRAMME AS AN OUT PATIENT. SINCE THEN SHE HAS LOST 70 KG AND TRANSFORMED HER LIFE.

…

JOHN
GIVEN HOW COMPLEX THE ADDICTION IS, HOW COMPLICATED IS THE REHAB PROCESS?

KAREN

WE LOOK TO EMPOWER BODY, MIND AND SPIRIT. BUT IT’S A PROCESS THAT GOES ON.

LINK
WE ASKED BONIWE TO KEEP A FOOD DIARY OVER THE COURSE OF A WEEKEND DOCUMENTING HOW MUCH SUGAR SHE WAS EATING.

ON SATURDAY SHE ATE:

4 LARGE SCONES (TEASPOONS OF SUGAR – 16)
1 PIECE OF KFC
1 TUB OF PRINGLES (18)
250 GRAMS OF CHUCKLES (28)
AND HALF A LITRE OF COKE. (11)

BONIWE CONSUMED A TOTAL OF 73 TEASPOONS OF SUGAR IN ONE DAY.


NICOLE
A LITTLE BIT OF SUGAR WON’T HURT YOU, IT’S NOT A BAD THING IN GENERAL. BUT THE WAY WE ARE CONSUMING IT, IT IS A BAD THING.

VO:

THE WORLD HEALTH ORGANISATION RECOMMENDS AN AVERAGE OF 5 TEASPOONS OF SUGAR A DAY. MANY PEOPLE UNKNOWINGLY CONSUME THIS AT BREAKFAST ALONE.

OVER 50% OF THE FOODS IN THE GROCERY STORE CONTAIN SUGAR - FROM BREAD, TO CEREAL BARS, TOMATO SAUCE, PASTA SAUCE, DRIED FRUIT, FRUIT JUICE, SWEETENED YOGHURT, SOME CEREALS AND EVEN SOME HEALTH PRODUCTS. ADDED SUGAR CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MOST LOW FAT ITEMS.

AS CITY PRESS JOURNALIST GRETHE KOEN DISCOVERED SWEETENED DRINKS HAVE UP TO 9 TEASPOONS OF SUGAR PER 340 ML. HER RESEARCH VERY QUICKLY WENT VIRAL AND HAS BEEN MAKING WAVES.

DEVI:
WHAT WAS SOME OF THE MOST SURPRISING FINDINGS?

GRETHE KOEN
THOSE DRINKS THAT YOU THINK ARE HEALTHY – FLAVOURED WATER HAS UP TO 5 TEASPOONS OF SUGAR IN IT. THE OTHER ONE IS YOGI SIP.

DEVI:
THERE ARE THOSE THAT SAY THAT SUGAR ADDICTION DOES NOT EXIST. WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO SAY?

BONIWE:
IT’S A REALITY, YOU WON’T KNOW UNTIL YOU LIVE WITH IT.

VO:
BONIWE HAS TAKEN STEPS TO ADDRESS HER ADDICTION AND REMAINS HOPEFUL THAT SHE WILL ONE DAY BE FREE OF SUGAR’S HOLD ON HER.

JOHN
PHYSICALLY YOU ARE A SHADOW OF YOUR FORMER SELF.. EMOTIONALLY YOURSELF X 10

MICHELLE
IF YOU HAD ASKED ME DURING MY ACTIVE ADDICTION, I WOULD HAVE TOLD YOU I HATE MYSELF. NOW, I LIKE MYSELF. .


__________________________________________________________________________






PROMOS

MICHELLE:
CHIPS, CHOCOLATE, BIG SLABS OF CHOCOLATE. I WOULD WALK UP AND DOWN THE AISLES IF I FILLED THE TROLLEY, NOT ENOUGH FOOD TO FILL THE HOLE INSIDE ME.
VO:
WE DELVE INTO THE WORLD OF SUGAR ADDICTION.


15”

BONIWE
I WANT TO CONSUME EVERYTHING..
VO:
EXCESSIVE CONSUMPTION OF SUGAR CAN LEAD TO OBESITY, DIABETES, HEART DISEASE, CANCER, LIVER FAILURE AND ADDICTION.
BONIWE
I COULD BE EATING MYSELF TO DEATH.


10”
KAREN:
ONE IS TOO MANY AND A THOUSAND IS NEVER ENOUGH. … ONCE I START I CANNOT STOP AND THAT IS WHAT ADDICTION IS. AND THAT IS WHY WHEN SUGAR ADDICTS EAT ONE BLOCK OF CHOCOLATE THEY HAVE TO FINISH IT THE REST.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Should sugar products come with a warning label? Research increasingly suggests that sugar is as addictive as alcohol and even cocaine.
metadata.Summary: Many of us as children were told not to eat sugar because it would rot our teeth.. But what if we had been told don’t eat too much sugar because it can cause obesity, diabetes, cataracts, mood related issues, addiction, promote the growth of cancer, heart disease and liver failure. Because that is the reality of the toll that added sugar can and probably will have on your health. In recent studies, sugar is regarded as being an addictive substance. Some researchers say, as addictive as cocaine. We look into the science behind why sugar is regarded as begin addictive. Speak to a neuro scientist, nutritionist, dietician and psychiatrist and ask them if sugar is addictive and why? Our 2 case studies demonstrate just how addictive sugar can be through their personal stories. We also look at hidden sugars and diseases that sugar can cause.
